metadata.command_line: /tmp/repo/experiments/eval_burst.py --checkpoint /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/seed42/best_val.pth --oracle_ranking_file /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/seed42/oracle_ranking.json --data_dir ./data --split test --importance oracle --schemes three_tier_25_50_25,two_tier_50_50,three_tier_25_25_50 --avg_losses 0.35,0.45 --burst_lengths 1,2,4,8,16 --seeds 0,1,2,3,4 --include_no_rs --workers 4 --device cpu --output_dir results/final/burst --wandb --wandb_project rs-uep-jscc --wandb_name kaggle-burst

evaluation.side_info_rule: 0 B for uniform/no_rs, one byte per channel for sorted methods
evaluation.mask_protocol: Gilbert-Elliott timeline mask shared by all methods; burst_length 1 = Bernoulli

insights: Based on 5 channel seed(s); 10000 images per seed. All gains below are paired per seed against the baseline (same packet losses), so they carry no luck-of-the-draw advantage.
No low-loss penalty: the best method is never more than 0.05 dB below `uniform` at any burst_length in this sweep.
Peak gain: +2.83 dB at burst_length = 2 by three_tier_25_25_50@oracle (95% CI ±0.02, significant).
Importance sources ranked by their best scheme's mean gain over burst_length >= 0: oracle#rr +2.20 dB, oracle +1.84 dB.
Worst-case images at burst_length = 1: 5th-percentile PSNR 17.11 dB (three_tier_25_25_50@oracle) vs 16.01 dB (uniform).
Worst-case images at burst_length = 16: 5th-percentile PSNR 14.75 dB (three_tier_25_50_25@oracle#rr) vs 14.30 dB (uniform).
Seed sensitivity: std across channel seeds stays below 0.3 dB everywhere.
`uniform` shows its steepest fall (0.01 dB) between burst_length = 1 and 2 -- its cliff.
